release_lifecycle_basis: Node 20 reached EOL 2025-04-30; Node 24 LTS is Active LTS (released 2025-05-06)

canonical_mechanism_chosen.rationale: The repository already enforces a single canonical Node setup action per architectural rule github_actions.reusable_setup (validated by .github/scripts/validate_actions.py which forbids inline setup-node). No new configuration architecture is needed — only update the existing canonical default and call sites.

local_dev_contract.rationale: .nvmrc is the lightest-weight standard mechanism recognized by nvm, fnm, Volta, asdf-node, and mise. It binds local dev to the same major version as CI without adding tooling.

manifest_contract.rationale: Tightens Node range to Node 24 major; npm will warn (not fail) on mismatch, but CI uses the canonical action so dev/CI parity is enforced through .nvmrc + canonical action.

verification_config_contract.note: Header comment says 'Do not edit manually' but node_version is a static infrastructure key with no CLI mutation command; it is updated as part of canonical runtime reconciliation.

package_manager_decision.rationale: npm 10.8.2 supports Node 24. No package manager upgrade required.

call_site_update_plan.summary: Update 8 workflow invocations + 1 action default + 3 supporting files = 12 minimal targeted changes. No architecture redesign.
files_to_change: start.sh (cosmetic message 'Node.js 18 or higher' → 'Node.js 24 or higher')
files_intentionally_unchanged_with_justi: runtime/generated/c31.1-provenance.json — historical certification provenance; immutable record of past CI Node 20.20.2 evidence
.github/scripts/validate_actions.py — linter for canonical contract; the modernization strengthens the canonical pattern
.github/workflows/m9-forensic-diagnostic-lab.yml — diagnostic reads ambient node (no pin); not a contract

version_specificity.rationale_for_major_only: actions/setup-node@v4 with node-version '24' resolves to the latest Node 24.x (currently 24.13.0). Pinning to a 24.x.y would cause perpetual drift and break cache hits; major-only is the GitHub-Actions-native convention for LTS.
version_specificity.lockfile_impact: frontend/package-lock.json may shift transitively if any installed package bumps for Node 24 support. Inspect diff before merging; reject drift unrelated to Node compatibility.
